title: Focus group on Open Portals for Adipose Tissue Biology
summary: Unlock the future of fat: join our Focus Group on July 10th, 2025 to review two cutting-edge open access portals in Adipose Tissue Biology.
bodyHtml:
Unlock the future of fat: join our Focus Group on July 10th, 2025 to review two cutting-edge open access portals in Adipose Tissue Biology. In this session we will introduce the Mammalian Adipose Tissue Knowledge Portal (MATKP; matkp.org) and Adipose Tissue Knowledge Portal (ATKP; adiposetissue.org).

Details on joining the presentation are below and are also embedded in this flyer. Please circulate it to interested colleagues! We hope to see you there, but we’ll also record and post the presentation for those who can’t make it.
